hypothesis: Choosing a duplicate difference as an explicit conflict and replacing one of its rows with a library candidate targeted at missing differences will improve row-mask packing beyond the untargeted best-response policy.
rationale: The prior row-library search maintained locally valid rows but reached only 96 unique differences. Its replacement objective did not explicitly select which duplicate conflict to remove. A conflict-directed move should preserve useful coverage while targeting the exact cause of non-disjointness; the library and integer verifier remain unchanged.
expected_information_gain: Tests whether explicit duplicate-conflict removal is a stronger global compatibility mechanism than generic best-response row swaps and whether the row-library representation can approach the 105-difference target.
method: Generate up to 100,000 deduplicated valid six-mark Golomb rulers with scope<=111 from uniform mark samples. Initialize seven-row states greedily. At each iteration count exact difference multiplicities, select a duplicated difference and a row containing it, sample replacement candidates indexed by currently missing differences plus random candidates, score by resulting overlap with the other six rows, and accept the minimum-overlap candidate with a fixed simulated-annealing escape rule. Restart after 500 stagnant iterations. Independently validate the best state with the integer DTS verifier.
metric: library cardinality, best exact union unique-difference count, duplicate set, packing iterations, restarts, target assignment, and independent DTS validity
metric_relation_to_true_objective: A validator-valid seven-row state with 105 unique differences and scope<=111 is exactly a true-objective witness; any lower union count or rejected state is proxy evidence only.
kill_condition: Stop at the first independently validated target witness, library/packing completion, or 120-second wall budget. Preserve the best state and do not call partial union improvement a DTS result.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: strict improvement only if complete and validator-valid

previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: same valid-row library with explicit duplicate-conflict targeting

interpretation: Pre-registered conflict-directed row-library search; no candidate claim is made before execution.
recommended_next_action: If a validator-valid scope-111 state appears, freeze and independently/adversarially verify it and perform provenance review; otherwise close row-library packing and return to algebraic decomposition.
repetition_justification: This changes the move-selection mechanism from generic union best-response to explicit duplicate-conflict targeting. It is not a seed, library-size, or runtime repeat.
